about: The goals Day by Word's plan list is grouped by (BUILD.md P9.3), in the engine's order (docs/engine.md, "Choosing a plan"), each with its plans in the order the list shows them. A plan may be in more than one goal, and every plan is in at least one. The compiler checks each goal's claim: whole-bible plans cover the whole Bible, new-testament plans read only the New Testament, gospels plans only the Gospels, and psalms-proverbs plans only Psalms and Proverbs; begin, a place to begin, is an editorial choice (docs/catalog-format.md, "Goals").
